Slaughterers can use incendiary bombs to destroy their foes, and they always have enough bullets. Slaughterers mostly use long-range weapons, so they have a disadvantage during melee attacks.
Tricksters do not have a distinct battle advantage, but they can do major damage when they directly attack their enemy's home base.
Gladiators are skilled with swords. They have high HP and AP. They can easily appoach their enemies and slice and dice them.
Duelists specialize in using shotguns. During combat, shotguns with sufficient bullets can be highly damaging and devastate the enemy quickly.
Incinerators are good at attacking multiple opponents at once. However, they have difficulty gathering up the energy for one strong shot, so they usually avoid 1 on 1 battles.
Combat officers succeed during group fights. When ally NPCs are near the combat officers, they will receive a hefty defense bonus.

Assasins - well, what more can I say? They inflict additional damage when attacking their foes. They are quite strong when fighting against other players, though they have no advantage when attacking NPCs or buildings.
Wreckers excel at destroying buildings. If given the chance, they will instantly obliterate their enemy's buildings and emerge victorious.
